title: FY2027 ICD-10-PCS selected procedure code descriptions
scope: Selected FY2027 inpatient ICD-10-PCS titles in up to eight illustrative categories: coronary, transfusion, ventilation, endotracheal, dialysis, extirpation, thrombolytic, and pacemaker; full source release ZIP preserved. Extirpation is a PCS operation title, not proof a code means thrombectomy.
